goal_ko: 애매한 말의 뜻을 묻고, 내 말을 풀어 설명하고, 상대 말을 정리해 확인하기

ok: sorry what do you mean by that

help.blank: What I ___ is I have a lot of work.

expressions.pattern: ^(?:what i mean is|what im saying is|in other words|i mean)(?: that)? (?<x>[a-z]+(?: [a-z]+){1,14})$

ok: What I mean is we need more time.
in other words I’m really busy
partial: because I have a lot of work

expressions.pattern: ^(?:so )?(?:youre saying|you are saying|you mean|are you saying)(?: that)? (?<x>[a-z]+(?: [a-z]+){1,14})$

ok: So you’re saying we should wait?

scene.en: Moa, the trip is a bit tricky this year.
What I mean is the hotels are almost full.
So you’re saying we should book now?

line_accept: what do you mean by tricky
so youre saying we should book now
youre saying we should book now

story_notice_ko: 토리 말이 애매할 때 뜻을 묻고, 내 말도 풀어 설명해요.

story.en: Our plan for Saturday is a little complicated.
story.screen_hint_ko: 뜻을 물어요: What do you mean by ‘complicated’?

branches.say: I mean the weather might be bad.

story.screen_hint_ko: 정리해 확인해요: So you’re saying we might cancel?

branches.when: matched_text:cancel|not go|postpone|another day|change the plan|stay home

branches.say: Not quite. I mean the weather might be bad, so we might cancel.

story.en: By the way, how’s your week going?

branches.say: Hmm, what do you mean by that?

story.screen_hint_ko: 풀어 설명해요: What I mean is ___. (I have a lot of work)

branches.say: Oh, I see. That makes sense.

ask_me.en: Now you check what I mean. The movie was… interesting.
ask_me.screen_hint_ko: 뜻을 물어요: What do you mean by ‘interesting’?

branches.say: What I mean is it was a little strange!

ask_me.screen_hint_ko: 정리해 확인해요: So you’re saying you didn’t like it?

branches.when: matched_text:didnt like|did not like|not good|boring|strange|weird|bad|not great

branches.say: Not exactly. I mean it was a little strange.

recall.hint_ko: 모아의 말이 애매하면 ‘What do you mean by…?’로 물어보세요
